extra_vocab.text: We’ve focused on making the stroller easier to use, from attaching and removing the seat to maneuvering and folding.
extra_vocab.zh: 我們一直專注於讓推車更容易使用，從安裝與取下座椅，到操控與折疊。
extra_vocab.note: 這是簡報最後的總結句，回顧前面示範的三大功能（Magic Connect、Sideways Movement、折疊），語氣肯定，強調產品設計的重點是「好用」。

chunks.en: from attaching and removing the seat

extra_vocab.structure: S + have + p.p.（focus on）+ V-ing + N + 比較級形容詞 + to V，from A（V-ing）to B（V-ing）

grammar.explain: focus on 的 on 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing（focused on making），不接原形動詞或 to V。
We’ve = We have，表示從過去一直到現在持續投入的努力，常用在簡報中總結「我們做了什麼」。
用來說明涵蓋的範圍（從…到…）。這裡 A 與 B 都是 V-ing 並列（attaching and removing … to maneuvering and folding），形式要一致。

extra_vocab.pattern: We’ve focused on + V-ing + N + 比較級 + to V, from V-ing to V-ing.

paraphrase.en: We have worked hard to make the stroller easier to operate, covering everything from installing and removing the seat to steering and folding it.
paraphrase.zh: 我們一直努力讓推車更容易操作，涵蓋從安裝與取下座椅到推行與折疊的每個步驟。

paraphrase.en: Making the stroller simple to use has been our main goal at every step, from attaching the seat to folding the frame.
paraphrase.zh: 讓推車使用簡單，一直是我們每個步驟的主要目標，從安裝座椅到折疊框架。

examples.en: We’ve focused on making the website easier to navigate, from searching for items to paying online.
examples.zh: 我們一直專注於讓網站更容易瀏覽，從搜尋商品到線上付款。

examples.en: We’ve focused on lowering our costs, from buying materials to shipping finished products.
examples.zh: 我們一直專注於降低成本，從採購材料到運送成品。
